jobs.title: Sr. Pipeline Engineer
jobs.location: France / Germany / Italy / Portugal / Spain / United Kingdom
jobs.facts: Build the front-ends for those tools across our surfaces: web (TypeScript/JavaScript), Qt/PySide desktop UIs, and in-engine tools in Unreal, with an emphasis on interfaces that are fast, responsive, and a pleasure to use. | UI/UX and front-end ability: you build responsive, intuitive interfaces (web with TypeScript/JavaScript, Qt/PySide desktop UIs, and in-engine tools) and care about the details of how they feel to use. | Excellent communication skills in fluent English, written and spoken (C1 or higher, near-native). | We are a fully remote team with no project managers, so clear, proactive communication is essential: you explain your technical decisions, align on priorities with the team,
